name: Snagajob
description:
Find hourly jobs on Snagajob without leaving the chat. Search by job title, location, or industry and browse listings from employers actively hiring near you. View job details, pay, and shift information, then head to Snagajob to apply when you're ready.

With Snagajob in the conversation, you can:

Search for hourly and part-time jobs near you
Filter by location, industry, and job type
View pay, hours, and employer details
Jump to Snagajob to apply in seconds
Whether you're looking for a first job, a side gig, or a full-time hourly role, Snagajob connects you to opportunities fast.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Snagajob to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Snagajob to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://platform.jobget.com/jobs-mcp/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Snagajob MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Snagajob scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Snagajob MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snagajob provides these MCP tools: get_job_details and search_jobs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Snagajob?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Snagajob in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Snagajob does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Snagajob is developed by JobGet. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
